identity_rule: a structure is admitted only if RDKit re-derives the exact requested InChIKey from the fetched SMILES
why_inchikey_roundtrip: PubChem returns several CIDs per InChIKey; the first CID is not necessarily the neutral liquid, so every candidate SMILES is tested instead of trusted
note: unresolved molecules are NOT silently dropped from the property tables; they simply have no structure and therefore no computed descriptor
